versions.changelog:
- Added detailed usage instructions for content atomization, covering multiple content types and formats.
- Included practical CLI-based examples for generating assets (e.g., quote cards, carousels, audiograms) using inference.sh.
- Introduced visual guides (e.g., "The Content Pyramid") and conversion recipes for common repurposing workflows.
- Provided checklists, platform adaptation guides, and a summary of common mistakes to avoid when repurposing content.
- Expanded description and trigger keywords to improve discoverability and clarify use cases.

Initial release: Turn one piece of content into many formats, covering major repurposing recipes and workflows.

- Supports blog-to-thread, blog-to-carousel, podcast-to-blog, video-to-quotes, and more.
- Includes detailed platform-specific adaptation rules and practical CLI examples using inference.sh.
- Offers a visual "content pyramid" framework and repurposing checklist.
- Covers common mistakes to avoid and best practices for multi-platform distribution.
- Useful for content marketing, social media, and content strategy.
